dedupe_keys.name: evaluation of transfer learning models for predicting the lateral strength of reinforced concrete columns

description: Evaluation of Transfer Learning Models for Predicting the Lateral Strength of Reinforced Concrete Columns is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Hongrak Pak, Texas A&M University (tamu.edu). Transfer learning aims to extract knowledge from one or more source tasks and apply the knowledge to a different task for more accurate predictions. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-b5z3-4m42. Keywords: Transfer learning; Machine learning; Reinforced concrete; Lateral strength; Seismic capacity. Published 2022-07-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
